pseudos.text: The cancellation of NEET-UG 2026 served as a decisive containment of an institutional breach. Following an uncovering of systemic rule-breaking via leaked exam materials, authorities moved swiftly to halt the compromised assessment. A law enforcement agency was engaged to restore institutional control, leading to the arrest of perpetrators of a systemic breach. The orderly process is now being restored with a rescheduled examination.

An enforcement action against disruptors culminated in thirteen arrests after an investigation initiated by a governing body. The referral to law enforcement followed evidence of a systemic breach involving exam preparation staff. This swift action by the investigation agency aims to restore order and integrity to the national testing system in India, a sovereign state facing a crisis of institutional trust.

The governing body, India's National Testing Agency, escalated its response by initiating a referral to law enforcement to investigate a leak of exam materials. This step was triggered by an information disclosure from an informant. The action represents an institutional authority restoring order after a challenge to its examination system, a planned event critical for national education.
